Name: Bounces
Description: Set the maximum number of light ray bounces. Default 100. Zero disables bouncing.

Name: LDR
Description: Compile with LDR

Name: HDR
Description: Compile with HDR

Name: Both
Description: Compile with HDR and LDR.

Name: Fast
Description: Fast lighting

Name: Final
Description: Increases the quality of light_environment and indirect lighting by spending more time firing rays.

Name: Extra Sky
Description: Trace N times as many rays for indirect light and sky ambient.
Warning: Default 1. -final raises it to 16 on the stock VRAD but only to 8 on tools++ VRAD, so an explicit 16 still buys quality there.

Name: Lights File
Description: Load a custom lights (RAD) file in addition to lights.rad and map-specific lights file.

Name: Smooth
Description: Set the smoothing threshold for brush faces without smoothing groups, in degrees.

Name: Luxel Density
Description: Scale down luxels. Maximum value is 1.
Warning: Too low a value can cause lighting errors.

Name: Static Prop Lighting
Description: Generate per-vertex prop_static lighting

Name: Static Prop Lighting Final
Description: Generate per-vertex prop_static lighting (uses higher/final quality processing)

Name: Static Prop Lighting Old
Description: Generate per-vertex prop_static lighting using the old algorithm

Name: Static Prop Bounce
Description: Enable static props to bounce light.

Name: Static Prop Sample Scale
Description: Controls quality of static prop lighting. Higher is slower and better. Stock VRAD defaults to 4, tools++ VRAD to 1.
Warning: -final already sets this: 16 on the stock VRAD, 4 on tools++ VRAD. Setting a lower number alongside -final lowers quality instead of raising it.

Name: Static Prop Polys
Description: Generate lighting on props at polygon precision.

Name: Static Prop Lighting Only
Description: Only perform direct static prop lighting.

Name: No self-shadowing props
Description: Globally disable self-shadowing on static props

Name: Texture Shadows
Description: Generates lightmap shadows from $alphatest and $translucent surfaces of models. (Not brushes)
Warning: Models must be compiled with $casttextureshadows or be listed with forcetextureshadow in the lights file

Name: AO Scale
Description: Scales the amount of baked AO. Stock VRAD defaults to 1.0, tools++ VRAD to 0.5.

Name: Threads
Description: Override the number of CPU threads used.

Name: Low Priority
Description: Force VRAD to run as a low-priority process.

Name: Normal Priority
Description: Run process with a normal process priority (be default below normal). Will prevent process from getting run on an efficiency core for certain CPUs
Warning: Using above normal process priority can cause other applications to become slow/unresponsive

Name: Disable Skybox Recursion
Description: Turn off recursion into 3d skybox (skybox shadows on world).

Name: Dump Prop Lightmaps
Description: Dump TGA versions of the lightmaps generated for prop_static models.

Name: No Extra
Description: Disable supersampling. This will lead to blockier, less accurate lighting

Name: Verbose
Description: Turn on verbose output for debug purposes.

Name: Ambient Occlusion
Description: Bakes ambient occlusion into lighting. Adds contact shadowing in corners and where props meet the world.

Name: AO Radius
Description: Radius of the ambient occlusion effect in units. Default 40.

Name: AO Prop Samples
Description: Number of ambient occlusion samples taken per static prop vertex. Higher is smoother and slower. Default 16, raised to 32 by -final and lowered to 12 by -fast.

Name: AO Face Samples
Description: Number of ambient occlusion samples taken per world face luxel. Higher is smoother and slower. Default 32, raised by -final and lowered to 16 by -fast.

Name: AO Debug
Description: Renders only the ambient occlusion term, for checking AO settings in isolation.
Warning: Debug output only, do not use for a final compile

Name: Extra Soft
Description: Multiplier on soft light samples, for softer shadow edges.

Name: Reflectivity Scale
Description: Scales the reflectivity of all materials, controlling how much light bounces off surfaces.

Name: World Texture Shadows
Description: Casts correct shadows from alphatest textures on world brushes, not just on props.

Name: Translucent Shadows
Description: Allows translucent textures to cast shadows tinted by their transparency.

Name: Force Texture Shadows
Description: Forces texture based shadows on every static prop, without needing them listed in a lights file.
Warning: Can be very slow on maps with many props

Name: Prop Ambient
Description: Lets static props occlude and shade the ambient cubes used by dynamic models.

Name: No Light Cull
Description: Disables the optimisation that discards lights below an intensity threshold.

Name: Min Light Cull Intensity
Description: Intensity below which a light is culled. Default 0.01. Lower keeps more faint lights.

Name: Min Styled Light Cull Intensity
Description: Cull threshold for named/styled (toggleable) lights. Default 1.

Name: Patch Lightmap Size
Description: Minimum lightmap size used when subdividing faces into patches. Default 16.

Name: Chop Texlights
Description: Allows faces emitting light via texlights to be subdivided, improving their light distribution.

Name: Fast Radial
Description: Uses a faster, slightly less accurate radiosity gathering pass.

Name: Large Disp Sample Radius
Description: Increases the sample radius on displacements, fixing black splotches on large displacement maps.

Name: Disp Sample Factor
Description: Multiplier on the direct lighting radius used for displacements. Default 1.

Name: Disp Patch Sample Factor
Description: Multiplier on the bounced lighting radius used for displacements. Default 1.

Name: Displacement Lighting Old
Description: Reverts to the legacy displacement lighting calculation, for matching older compiles.

Name: Static Prop Indirect Mode
Description: Restores the old static prop vertex lighting behaviour for indirect light.

Name: Indirect Only
Description: Bakes only indirect (bounced) light, omitting direct light. Useful for debugging bounce.
Warning: Debug output only, do not use for a final compile

Name: Prop Debug
Description: Reports which static props are taking the longest to light, for tracking down slow compiles.

Name: No Pair Edges
Description: Disables lightmap edge pairing between faces on the same entity.

Name: No Pair Geometric Edges
Description: Disables lightmap edge pairing between geometrically adjacent faces.
